QuestInfo.name: The Student Becomes the Master
QuestInfo.0: You have returned to the Underground Base with #p2151000#. Talk to #p2151000# to see if he's fully recovered.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2151000# says he's made a full recovery, but doesn't think he can ever be quite as strong as you have shown yourself to be. In light of this, he's decided to teach you his most powerful skill. He believes that you can put this skill to greater use than he ever could.

Become the hero #p2151000# believes you to be. Drive the Black Wings out, and return peace to Edelstein!
